_meta.title: Motor and inverter correlation, bench, fixed supply then pack
_meta.status: DRAFT, written before any hardware exists
_meta.author: Alifizz01
_meta.purpose: Decide what must be measured, to what tolerance, and why, BEFORE buying sensors or running anything. Every tolerance here is provisional until the actual instruments are known.
_meta.discipline: Predictions for these operating points are frozen to data/predicted_spec_1.json before the bench runs. A tolerance widened after seeing data is not a tolerance.

setup.device_under_test: BLDC/PMSM motor + ESC, clamped, fan or brake load. NO PROPELLER.
setup.load_type: fan, so load torque ~ rpm^2, same law as a propeller
setup.why_two_configurations: Config A removes the pack from the loop so any disagreement is motor or inverter. Config B adds the pack. Errors that appear only in B belong to the pack model. Testing both at once cannot separate them.

A.supply: bench power supply, constant voltage, current limited

instruments._note: accuracies below are PLACEHOLDERS. replace with the datasheet figure of the instrument actually bought, then revisit every tolerance.

i_dc.device: inline shunt or hall sensor, logged

temp_c.device: NTC or thermocouple on the motor case

scenario.name: duty_sweep
scenario.description: Step the ESC duty, let each point settle, log steady-state values.
scenario.order: ascending, then descending, to expose thermal hysteresis between the two passes

requirements.justification: shunt accuracy 2 %, plus expected model error from holding winding resistance constant with temperature. The dominant term is the model, not the sensor.
sensor is near exact. 5 % is model error, dominated by k_e being taken from datasheet Kv rather than measured.

config A holds this constant by definition, so it only tests anything in B. Tight, because sag is a simple IR drop with nothing else in it. If this fails, r_internal or the wiring resistance is wrong.

absolute, not relative, because a relative tolerance on a temperature near ambient is meaningless. 5 K covers NTC placement on the case rather than in the winding, plus the missing thermal mass in the model.
derived from u_bus and i_dc, so NOT independent of REQ-01 and REQ-03. Kept because a power error that is not explained by either input signal indicates a timing or averaging mistake in the logging.

safety_limits._note: hard stops. exceeding any of these aborts the run, no exceptions.
safety_limits.i_max_a: whichever is lower, ESC rating or motor rating
rules: motor clamped down before power is applied
no propeller fitted at any time, fan or brake load only
LiPo charged in a fireproof bag, never unattended
DC bus current sensing verified working before anything spins

acceptance.per_point: a point passes when every requirement applying to its configuration passes
acceptance.overall: SPEC-1 passes when all 8 points pass in both configurations
acceptance.on_failure: a failing requirement is not a defect until the residual is explained. Report the residual, its sign, and whether it is systematic or scattered. A systematic bias points at a wrong parameter; scatter points at the measurement.
acceptance.deliverable: one table of predicted vs measured per signal, the worst error, and a sentence naming the physical cause of any systematic bias
